channel.title: News Bot — TechCrunch AI (Tech & AI)
channel.description: RSS-Feed für die Quelle 'TechCrunch AI' (Kategorie: Tech & AI).

item.title: Google takes Dreambeans to India in bid to bring AI-generated personal stories to the masses
item.description: Google's Dreambeans, its latest AI experiment, now supports 13 Indian languages.

item.title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing…something with third-party AI apps
item.description: Apple hinted at ways that it could spur revenue through third-party "opportunities" during its Monday night earnings call.

item.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
item.description: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.

item.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
item.description: The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.

item.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
item.description: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.

item.title: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
item.description: The website builder said that the job losses are part of a broader restructuring of its organization.

item.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
item.description: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.

item.title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
item.description: Here's a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?

item.title: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs
item.description: Musk recently referred to Grok Bot as having "the fastest growth of a product that I've ever seen in my life."

item.title: Omen AI adds liquid know-how in $16 million Aquatic Labs acquisition
item.description: Two startups tackling the data center water problem are joining forces in a $16 million deal.

item.title: 2 days till TechCrunch Founder Summit: Boston founders don’t need a Silicon Valley address to build something big
item.description: TechCrunch Founder Summit happens on November 4 in Boston for a founder-focused agenda and impactful connections. Save up to $100 or get discounts with group passes.

item.title: OpenAI is finally merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work tabs
item.description: OpenAI said that ChatGPT and Codex will draw usage from the same allocation pool after this change.
